description: Personal travel profile for the Extreme Travel Opportunity Radar. This is configuration, not code: routes, priorities and sampling defaults live here so nothing is hardcoded through the application. Wildcard destinations are declared for later phases and deliberately NOT scanned by default.

wildcard.note: Config only for Phase 4 — powers TAKE ME ANYWHERE / EXTREME HOLIDAY DEALS later. Not seeded into observation jobs.

observer.note: Defaults applied when seeding observation jobs. Every value can be overridden per job in the database.
observer.atfNote: ATF is excluded from scheduled observation on purpose: one search costs 5 of ~150 monthly calls. It stays reserved for manual validation and explicit high-value checks.

dateStrategy.cashTripTypesNote: Return is what actually gets booked on these routes. One-way is collected because every award source integrated so far prices ONE direction, and a CPP is only honest against a cash fare of the same trip type - without one-way cash the CPP component (20% of the award score) is dropped for every award the observer collects. Both use the free provider, so this costs seconds per run, not quota.
